ratio.arithmetic: 130 / 968.8 = 13.4 per 100 (2024 electorate). Cross-check on the pre-SIR base: 13.37 crore / about 94.8 to 95.6 crore = 14.0 to 14.1 per 100 (Outlook: 14.1%). Final-roll view, Bihar + Phase 2 only: about 5.65 to 6.2 crore / 58.9 to 61.4 crore = about 9.6 to 10 per 100.
ratio.caveat: The SIR now covers almost the whole country (30 States/UTs; only Assam, J&K, Himachal deferred), so dividing by the national electorate is defensible, but 13 is the draft-stage ratio: names deleted from draft rolls, some later restored, Phase 3 not final. Label as 'about 13 in 100 ... so far' and attribute: 'reported', with the BJP/ECI-data caveat. 969M is the Feb 2024 roll, not the roll at SIR start.
